title: Debbie P NDE 4186/7001 NDE 7001
content:
7001 I felt like I woke up and saw my body lying in the pool. I had a red or blue swimsuit on and I saw bubbles coming out of my nose. I was floating above my body and was asking myself why I was lying there. I heard air rushing past me and was looking at my body and wondering why I was down there. I was not afraid. It was like I was watching a movie. After a few minutes, I starting going higher and higher away to the blue and white clouds. It reminds me of looking out of an airplane. I did not fly, but was lifted. Suddenly, I felt a jolt like an electrical shock and I was awake. I tried to tell my mom years later, but she refuses to believe me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. Drowning Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was in the baby pool and another child pushed me under the water and was holding me down. | Yes Accident. Criminal attack drowning 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' A small boy was holding me under the water.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | A landscape or city | Light
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes At the end, I heard screams and saw my mom's legs running through the water. I woke up in a jolt in my mom's arms. I clearly left my body and existed outside it | Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal | More consciousness and alertness than normal I do not remember the actual pushing down in the water. The experience was automatic and instant. I remembered the actual drowning occurring. I saw it so clear, and can still see it now.
elements.At what time during the experience were: The entire time I was watching the 'movie.' It was totally regal and I could hear people screaming and rushing by me. Sharper senses, colors. | I do not remember the actual pushing down in the water. The experience was automatic and instant. I remembered the actual drowning occurring. I saw it so clear, and can still see it now.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: No | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I knew I was someplace different and experiencing something different.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: The experience was about me. The vision was clear, very clear, calm, silent, then back to my body. It was like I was watching myself die and it was clear and not scary. It was sharp and colorful. | The colors were brighter and lighter, but soft and not hard to look at. It was crystal clear and sharp. I could see in different dimensions. It is hard to describe. I was hovering low and then so high I could see the shape of the earth.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I heard crisp sounds like air rushing past me. It sounded calm and serene. It was a sharper sound. | I did not hear the pool, screaming, water, splashes, and voices. I only heard a soft air sound like fast air passing by. It was calming. I heard nothing else. When I came back, I was awoken by the loud noises of pool activity.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out | Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No | No No, darn it! I remember being jolted back into consciousness. It was very bothersome.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: No | A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: No | Yes It was a very clear light and very sharp. The light was not surrounding me. It was everywhere.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: No | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was in a different time and dimension. It was real time and normal. It seemed to get faster toward the end when I was thrown back into my body.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was thinking, 'why am I lying down in the pool.' I saw myself drowning and was not scared one bit. It reminds me of a factual event. It was happening, and I did not care. I started going higher from my body and going into the sky, moving fast, going higher and higher. I was not afraid. I was calm and traveling. I felt great. | I was totally calm. I was above my body thinking to myself, 'why am I under the water?' I was not scared. I was just watching my body drown. It was very matter-of-fact.
elements.Did you have a feeling of peace or pleas: Incredible peace or pleasantness | Relief or calmness
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: No | My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: No | Scenes from the world's future
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No | I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion | point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Protestant I was only three. | Conservative/fundamentalist I believed in God and Jesus
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes Not a church goer. I do not believe in judgment or being saved. | Uncertain I was so young when it happened. It made a big difference as I got older. I have become a better person in many ways.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Protestant I am a spiritual person and do not believe Jesus saves people. I do not believe in judgement or a mean God. | Moderate active Presbyterian
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I was three.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Not at that time, but as I grew I did begin to remember and it did change me. | Uncertain I was so young when it happened. It made a big difference as I got older. I have become a better person in many ways.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: No | I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion | ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Uncertain It was like I was moving on. I knew I was dying. I knew I was moving up to another place.
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Not fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes Yes As I got older it did change everything. | Yes As I get older, I see the experience affecting my beliefs and the way I treat other people.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Yes As I got older it did change everything. After the NDE | tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes As I get older, I see the experience affecting my beliefs and the way I treat other people. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: No Not really, but no one believed me.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I can travel outside my body. | Yes As I got older, I became increasingly more interested in spiritual happenings and read everything I could on near death experiences. I felt like the subject was drawing me in. I wanted to read everything I could. I read all the Raymond Moody books, and saw several movies about NDEs. I was very into the subject. When I had my disabled daughter, I began to see her angels and feel their presence in the house. I saw a heavenly body in my yard walking toward me. I have seen our old sweet neighbor standing outside her home after the week she died. I am still very interested in all types of spiritual events.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: No. | All of the experience was awesome and made me a real believer. I know God is with me. I have experienced the process of death and I am not scared. It is a peaceful experience.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My parents, friends, and some mediums. My parents both think I am nuts and everyone else believes me. | Yes It took me a long time to tell anyone. I told my husband. I just told him about a year ago. I do not really know what he thinks. He knows I believe it. I think he believes me because of our daughter's angels. I told two friends who thought it was neat. I want people to not be scared to die. It is not scary at all. It gave me peace.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Just thought I saw myself die and come back. | Experience was definitely real I was so little when it happened that I never thought about it as strange. It was normal, but special. I started thinking more about it as I got older. I was a silly heart at age four!
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real | Experience was definitely real I love it! I feel so special. I am still scared to say much to other people. Many may think I am not well. I am so interested in other people's NDEs. I like to share my story with those who have lost someone. I hope it gives them peace.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I would love to talk with others who have had the same experience. I love the Lord so much! I am not afraid of death.
